programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1723
programme.desc: To vinnere av lipsync-konkurransen skal kåres, men med mye uoppgjort i luften er stemningen på hotellet anspent. Alliansen slår store sprekker, og i utgangspunktet tunge valg blir lettere å ta.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1724
programme.desc: Det er klart for Pandoras eske, hvor sannheter skal frem i lyset. Stian skal velge seg en partner, og må dermed sende en annen gjest hjem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1725
programme.desc: En helt absurd og sursøt uke treffer paradiset som en bombe. Røde knapper og anonyme telefoner skaper kaos på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1726
programme.desc: Den mystiske knappen leverer en absurd kostymefest, og hotellet eksploderer i drama.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1727
programme.desc: Noen våkner med ængst. Og når den rosa telefonen ringer, må det legges nye planer.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 318
programme.desc: Det er menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris. I går gav restaurantsjef Abu alle en fridag, og deltakerne får seg noen store overraskelser når de begynner å lese oppskriftene bare timer før Kjartan kommer.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 319
programme.desc: Etter tidenes dårligste menysmaking i går har restaurantsjef Abu en formidabel oppgave foran seg før dagens servering. Det blir en intens servering hvor alt ikke går helt som planlagt.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 320
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp Kulinaris. Etter å ha snudd nederlag til tidenes beste servering i går, må restaurantsjef Abu i dag ta et vanskelig valg å velge ut en førstelærling.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 321
programme.desc: Denne uka får deltakerne den hittil vanskeligste menyen å bryne seg på, og den nye restaurantsjefen kjører sin helt egne lederstil. Runar forsvinner igjen i løse lufta når det skal jobbes.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 322
programme.desc: Det står menysmaking på programmet på Camp Kulinaris. Restaurantsjef Aurora sliter med sykdom hos mannskapet sitt. Kaos oppstår på kjøkkenet og ikke alle retter kommer i mål til Kjartan kommer.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 911
programme.desc: Svein fortsetter jakten på gode råd til reisetips-boken sin, og får i dag hjelp fra familien Haider. Hilde møter nye utfordringer da hun tar seg strøjobb i en fornøyelsespark.

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 101
programme.desc: I første episode blir vi kjent med Fetsund-gutta. Disse seks kompisene satser knallhardt på fyll, fest og galskap i Syden. Det blir også et gjensyn med Mario og Marthe, kjent fra Paradise hotel 2019.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1009
programme.desc: Tålmodigheten til Buskerudgjengen blir satt på prøve når de blir sendt av gårde til et røykfritt helsesenter. Fred Åge og Sven Erik drar på fisketur, og vennegjengen fra Kløfta, ankommer ferieøya.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Lillian Müller ankommer Tenerife, men Svein har forsovet seg. Familien Haider får trøbbel med leiebilen sin. Onkel Erling og Stein Are skal på en strabasiøs grottetur. Cathrin og Odin er på stranda.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Sjarmøren “el Roger” kommer frem i lyset når Roger skal på date. Paradisegjengen drar til en huleboerlandsby, men Bendik Romeo er skeptisk. Det planlegges overraskelsesfest for Aslaug, som fyller 60.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1114
programme.desc: Gjengen fra Buskerud ankommer Tenerife. Lars og teatervennene tester ut paragliding, mens Stein Are og onkel Erling er på vikingtokt. Gude-familien drar på en tøff treningsøkt.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 603

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 401
programme.desc: Langt ute i havgapet, utenfor Helgelandskysten, finner du Myken. Her skal gutta pusse opp et 100 år gammelt fyr.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 403
programme.desc: Med panoramautsikt til majestetiske Geirangerfjorden skal gutta pusse opp ei gammel og slitt hytte på en setervoll. Og det er nettopp seterlivet som er tema for oppussingen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 804
programme.desc: Gutta reiser til Finnmark for første gang, nærmere sagt Bugøynes. Her sammenlignes hytta med «huset på prærien» og stikkord som «ville vesten» og «ralph lauren» setter stilen. Ole får lekt seg med gamle materialer, og Halvor setter malingsrekord.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 502
programme.desc: I sesongens andre episode drar våre oppussingsgenier til en hytte utenfor idylliske Lillesand. Det blir en uforglemmelig uke med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 905
programme.desc: Rett utenfor Stavanger ligger Randøy, og her finnes ei hytte med en litt uvanlig fasong. Eierne sliter med en stor trapp som tar mye plass, men det har gutta en løsning på.

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Ellinor har solgt huset og skal re-starte livet. Til tross for god inntekt sliter hun. Ekspertene blir med på flytteprosessen, og får sjokk over hvor mye penger som går til unødvendige kjøp.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2301

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2303

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Daniel fra Siggerud fikk sitt første kredittkort som 17-åring og er siden blitt nedsyltet i gjeld. Kjæresten hans, Pia, håper at Magne og Hallgeir kan klare å ordne opp i Daniels gjeldskaos.

programme.desc: Cartman får 'gingervitus' og tar opp kampen mot forfølgelsen av rødhårede.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman suger
programme.desc: Butters blir sett i en kompromitterende stilling med Cartman og sendes til omvendingsleir for homofile. Cartman prøver å få tilbake et bilde av det som skjedde.

programme.title: South Park: Menneskebjørngrisen
programme.desc: Guttene hjelper tidligere visepresident Al Gore i jakten på oppmerksomhet og blir innesperret i en hule. Cartman prøver å finne veien ut og oppdager en skatt.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman har fått en angstdiagnose.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Kaos
programme.desc: Gutta gir Butters sparken som venn og vekker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Butter slår tilbake
programme.desc: Butters blir i hemmelighet plaget av sin bestemor og Stan ønsker å øke bevisstheten om farene ved mobbing. Stans idé er å spille inn en stor dansevideo, men suksessen raskt går til hodet på ham.

programme.title: South Park: City Sushi
programme.desc: Når Butters involverer seg i en Asiatisk bakkekrig, oppdager foreldrene hans at han har flere personligheter og bestemmer at medisinering er eneste utvei.

programme.title: South Park: Den ustoppelige
programme.desc: Evig uskyldige Butters er lei behandlingen han får av foreldrene, og blir litt for oppslukt av den nye vampyrfeberen.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Når gutta reiser til Aspen for å stå på ski for første gang, legger Stan seg ut med lokalbefolkningen og blir utfordret til et løp.

programme.title: South Park: Hva skjer med landet?
programme.desc: Garrison vil bygge en mur for å holde alle immigrantene uten dokumentasjon ute.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle ber Butters i stedet for Cartman til bursdagsfest. Cartman overbeviser Butters om at en meteoritt vil treffe jorden, og gjemmer ham i et tilfluktsrom så han kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: Rosiner
programme.desc: Stan blir dumpet av Wendy og blir goth for å leve ut smerten.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om at jentene har en dings som kan spå fremtiden, så Butters kler seg ut for å infiltrere deres rekker.

programme.title: South Park: Den siste meksikaner
programme.desc: Da en grensepatruljelek går galt, ender Butters opp med å gjenopplive den meksikanske stoltheten, men Cartman er forberedt på å la leken slutte der.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er fanget i Imaginationland og må kjempe for livet mot en hær av onde krefter. Kyle og Cartman er fortsatt i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Guttene kommer til et magisk land der hele verdens fantasi ligger foran dem, men terroristplaner truer med å ødelegge alt sammen.

programme.title: South Park: Vesenet
programme.desc: Kyles fetter Kyle Schwartz flytter til South Park på grunn av morens helseproblemer. Til å begynne med er Kyle glad for besøket, men det går ikke lang tid før 'Kyle 2' begynner å irritere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons nye vakre vagina
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison skifter kjønn, og Kyle får en 'uvanlig' operasjon som gjør ham høy og sprek nok til å komme på basketballaget.

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Det er en Jersey-greie
programme.desc: Byen South Park må forsvare seg mot å bli overkjørt av New Jersey og realitystjernene derfra.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Kyle blir kidnappet av Apple etter å ha unngått å lese et kontraktstillegg. Apple har store planer med ham, og det må bli gutta som redder ham.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyforbundet

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen

programme.title: South Park: Vulkanen

programme.title: South Park: Døden

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon

programme.title: South Park: Datakalenderen
programme.desc: Cartman skryter av sin nye Trapper Keeper, men en fremmed forteller ham at den snart vil ta over verden om de ikke ødelegger den nå.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Sykkelparaden

programme.desc: Borgermesteren vil lage en høytidsfeiring som ikke støter noen, og Kyle tror han har løsningen.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Matt finally moves out and Dad visits the hospital via the emergency room.

programme.title: 7th Heaven

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Eric counsels a young man who feels his wife should be meek and subservient, while Annie and the girls rally for women's rights in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 211

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Matt LeBlanc og Chris Harris prøver å få fart på britiske veier - og landbruk. Matt tester også en Ferrari 812 Superfast, og Rory Reid drar til USA for å prøvekjøre en muskelbil som er forbudt i Europa. Vicky McClure er ukens gjest i studio.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Matt LeBlanc, Chris Harris og Rory Reid tester nye SUV-er ved hjelp av hestestevner. Chris får seg en eksplosiv kjøretur i den nye Alpine A110, og Jason Manford er kveldens gjest i studio.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1002

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1003

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1004

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Janni og Amalie vil arrangere et morsomt og festlig sosialt arrangement for alle fruene. Men hva skjer når Janni plutselig blir alene om arrangementet.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1006

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2703

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Southwest Jutland

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: If The Shoes Fit...
programme.desc: A fast-talking politician named Bo Gumbs who’s running for Governor. He learns his true colors while staying at a hotel for a meeting.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Levitation
programme.desc: A teenager enraptured with magicians goes to a flee-bitten circus to seek out one of the greatest ever: Kharma. However, Kharma now does cheap magic for the crowds, and none of the great illusions the teenager believed he was capable of.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: It All Comes Out In The Wash
programme.desc: Carl Gropper, a greedy developer, stumbles upon a Chinese laundry that offers a unique service - it can "wash out" guilt. Carl employs their services but soon finds there is an unpleasant price to pay.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Bigalow'S Last Smoke

programme.title: JAG: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Mac defends and Turner prosecutes in the case of a special op marine who, during an Iraqi mission, may have deserted his team for his own survival. Harm takes on a CIA training assignment in a mach six craft that soon has him in danger.

programme.title: JAG: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Back at JAG, Harm is flooded with cases but still wants to help out an 80-year-old veteran accused of robbery. Meanwhile, Turner takes on an assignment in a sub whose crew has rescued possible defecting North Koreans.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.title: JAG: Good Intentions
programme.desc: Mac defends a petty officer and former alcoholic accused of a brutal murder after a drinking binge which renders him useless in remembering details that could help him. Roberts is entangled in the case of a Navy Commander accused of embezzling funds.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Miss Mom, Who's The Champ, Gopher's Delusion

programme.title: The Love Boat: Egyptian Cruise - Part 1

programme.title: The Love Boat: Egyptian Cruise - Part 2

programme.title: The Love Boat: Hello Emily, The Tour Guide, The Winning Number

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Second Time Around, Hello, Spencer, Runaway, Go Home
programme.desc: Emily Haywood (Marion Ross) returns for a second consecutive cruise as her affection for Captain Stubing grows and Larry Gatlin and the Gatlin Brothers try to help a teenage stowaway.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
programme.desc: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bring My Baby Home
programme.desc: A four-week-old girl is kidnapped, leaving her mother in anguish and police scrambling to find her. Joe Kenda and Robert Sapp fear she’s been sold on the black market… or worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Weapon of Choice
programme.desc: When mother of two Shaundra Murr is run over in front of her house, officers initially suspect a hit and run. Until Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers evidence proving Shaundra’s murder was a crime of passion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Slaughterhouse Six
programme.desc: Solider and young father Layne Schmidtke is brutally beaten to death by a mob of teenagers. Kenda must reconstruct the chaotic scene through forensic evidence and witness testimonies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Jury Room: Jack Whomes
programme.desc: Three members of a drug gang are shot and killed at point blank range. The Jury Room will debate the case of Jack Whomes, a ruthless killer or an innocent suffering a miscarriage of Justice?

programme.title: Jury Room: Ben Geen
programme.desc: A clutch of incidents sees elderly patients become inexplicably and seriously ill at an Oxfordshire hospital. A Nurse is arrested and incriminating evidence is found. But did he, do it?

programme.title: Jury Room: Omar Benguit
programme.desc: Jong-Ok Shin, a native of Korea, is stabbed and killed. Omar Benguit was arrested and convicted of murder. Was he a drug-crazed killer or innocent and suffering a miscarriage of Justice?

programme.title: Very Scary People: The Dating Game Killer: Smooth Talker (Part 1)

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et fotballag girer seg opp før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møter Hillary Clinton, to karer forbereder seg på potensielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er litt for skyteglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Landlord
programme.desc: I sesongfinalen vil president Obama behandles som alle andre, Jordan ser på en leilighet som er eid av en mistenksom utleier, og et par festfiksere som vil få gang i festen på en bar mitzvah.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En flyvert må håndtere en passasjer som ikke vil ha på sikkerhetsbeltet, britiske oppdagelsesreisende diskuterer sine reiser, to par forsøker å unngå spoilere på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe opplever en guddommelig intervensjon.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: President Obama og hans vredeoversetter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møter mannen som skulle holde tale etter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner prater om hva som skjer med bæsjen deres atter at de skyller ned.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respektert kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrytelser, benytter ukonvensjonelle metoder for å løse en sak, en actionhelt redder kjæresten sin og en ansatt i en butikk med yoghurt-is tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har noen nye låter, en mann kan ikke slutte å si "deez nuts", Keegan må ringe 112 og en ung mann lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Boarding Group One
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Keegan ikke får lov å gå om bord i flyet sitt, en bølle som nekter å helle ut innholdet i spritflaska og en bokser som sviner til modstanderen sin.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En fotballspiller med hjerneskade prøver å inspirere laget sitt, en mann anklager sin kone for å være utro med en hund og en restauranteier skremmer bort gjestene sine.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bone Thugs And Homeless
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en hund som plager en nyhetsreporter og Harriet Tubman som løper fritt omkring.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: Kileleking mellem to venner blir plutselig merkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistenker vennen sin for å stjele og Keegan og Jordan diskuterer Afrika på en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer Keegan som blir distraheret mens han snakker i telefon med kjæresten sin, at Keegan og Jordan har en ondskapsfull sjef og hvordan et nytt uttrykk blir til.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Matt LeBlanc, Chris Harris og Rory Reid tester nye SUV-er ved hjelp av hestestevner. Chris får seg en eksplosiv kjøretur i den nye Alpine A110, og Jason Manford er kveldens gjest i studio.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: I den første episoden tar Evans og LeBlanc en temmelig våt kjøretur til Blackpool i et par Reliant trehjulinger uten tak.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Sharleen Spiteri, Seasick Steve og Tinie Tempah tar den ultimate SUV-testen i villmarken i Sør-Afrika, mens Damian Lewis er dagens stjerne i rallycross-bilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Chris Evans sliter med å holde lunsjen nede mens han rir med Sabine Schmitz i den nye Audi R8. I mellomtiden får Matt LeBlanc en kort valgturné i London.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Tinas planer om å dra til OL blir utfordret når hesten hennes er med om en ulykke. Karina og Tina bestemmer seg for å invitere alle fruene på et spaopphold på et nytt hotell.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Alle er travelt opptatt med juleforberedelsene. Det er Tina og familiens første ordentlige danske jul, og Janni har store planer om å arrangere en julelunsj for alle fruene på Vedbæklund.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Amalie fyller år, og Janni arrangerer en overraskelsesfest for henne og de andre fruene, men hvordan blir det å samles igjen etter konflikten mellom Janni og Gunnvør?

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Tina og Allan har bestemt seg for å skaffe en hund, og spesielt Louis blir positivt overrasket. I mellomtiden skal Karsten delta i et løp for veteranbiler.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Janni skal gjøre en viktig og avgjørende undersøkelse av lungene, som hun er veldig nervøs over. Tina skal gifte seg igjen og har bestemt seg for å finne den perfekte brudekjolen ved hjelp av Jackie og Gunnvør.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Tina og familien hennes har dratt til Ibiza for å fornye hennes og Allans bryllupsløfter. Hjemme står Jackie i et stort dilemma angående den kommende mageoperasjonen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2705
programme.desc: Johan fra Helsingborg unnslipper følelsene sine ved å kjøpe dyre biler. Selv om han er sykemeldt på grunn av depresjon og utmattelse, fortsetter han å kjøpe ting som om det ikke finnes noen morgendag.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2706
programme.desc: 25 år gamle Sanne fra Hjo har aldri vært bra oå økonomi, men da søsteren plutselig døde for drøyt et år siden, ga hun helt opp. Gjelden hoper seg opp, og hun klarer ikke å betale regningene sine.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2707
programme.desc: Karl-Henrik fra Uppsala låner penger fra sin pensjonerte mor, som nå taper penger. Det blir en uke der mor Annie og Karl-Henrik blir nødt til å endre sitt syn på hverandre.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2708
programme.desc: De unge foreldrene Simon og Andjela fra Luleå får snart sitt andre barn, men har fremdeles ikke mottatt noen foreldrepenger for sin førstefødte.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2709
programme.desc: Fembarnsmoren, Catarina fra Bottnaryd, brenner broer til høyre og venstre som et resultat av hennes spilleavhengighet. Hun har mistet kontakten med flere av barna sine og holder nå på å miste huset sitt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2801
programme.desc: Per og Jael har kastet bort hundretusenvis av kroner på tekniske duppeditter og luksusleker til barna sine. Nå kollapser hele familiens økonomi når en gjeld på 100 000 svenske kroner har havnet hos namsmannen.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: På randen til havari i ekteskap og karriere drar den arbeidsløse forfatteren Jack Spencer og hans kone Amanda på ferie. Med en uventet dobbeltbooking blir den private, romantiske luksusen alt annet enn privat og romantisk.

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog
programme.desc: Når Olive og Clay møttes var det kjærlighet ved første blikk, de giftet seg, kjøpte seg hus og adopterte en nyfødt valp - Wesley. Nå er det 6 år siden, og de har bestemt seg for å skille lag, og begge ønsker å ta sin elskede Wesley med seg.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert føler seg innesperret, i en kjedelig amerikansk småby, med ansvar for sin autistiske lillebror og bevegelseshemmete mor. Men en dag kommer Becky til byen, og snart oppstår det et skjørt og spesielt vennskap dem imellom.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: Adventures of Aladdin
programme.desc: Aladdin is recruited to steal a magic lamp. But when he uses its powers to help him win the heart of the newly appointed Sultana, it opens up a whole new world of excitement and danger.

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Hayden Christensen spiller hovedrollen i denne kritikerroste sanne historien om en vanæret journalist, regissert og delvis skrevet av Billy Ray, den Oscar®-nominerte forfatteren av CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

programme.title: End of the World
programme.desc: As mass of solar storms causes tsunamis, volcanoes, and flooding, a city-dwelling family attempts to flee to the relative safety of a group of high-elevation caves several miles away.

programme.title: Fire never i Rio
programme.desc: De rike fetterne Antonio og Sebastiano Coimbra er to brasilianske mangemillionærer som lever i frykt for yrkesmordere. Derfor ansetter de to dobbeltgjengere, Greg Wonder som er en kriminelt belastet saxofonspiller, og stuntmannen Eliot Vance.

programme.title: Aliens in the Attic
programme.desc: Pearson-ungene bruker oppfi nnsomhet, mot og dyktighet i videospill mot noen hissige, små, grønne romvesener som krasjlander på familiens sommerhus.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Det var en gang … en vakker pike som het Samantha.Hun hadde alt hun kunne ønske seg, og hun bodde i etvakkert, hvitt hus. Det hvite hus! Katie Holmes spillerhovedrollen som Samantha Mackenzie, en skjermet, ung som bare vil ha en normal skolegang.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: No Eggspectations
programme.desc: Kara foreslår en levende versjon av 'Talk Back', men verken hun eller Mary Jane er forberedt på nyheten dr. Marrs kommer med. Cameron og Niecy forhandler om hans gjenkomst i hennes liv.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Pulling The Trigger
programme.desc: Mary Janes hormoner kommer ut av kontroll når hun får en hCG-sprøyte, noe som gir eggløsning om 36 timer. Hun tilbys en eksklusiv historie av Sheldon DeWitt, noe som presser hennes allerede anstrengte vennskap med Lisa.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Let's Go Crazy

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Witches and Vampires Haunting St James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Liverpool's Secret Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into Woolton Hall, a derelict mansion in Liverpool. They appear to be forced out of the building by an unknown force and it takes its toll on one of the team members.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Spirits at The Lord Eldon
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travels to the old town of Knutsford, Cheshire to investigate the historic Lord Eldon Inn, hoping to contact the spirit of Sarah Ann Pollitt who is said to haunt the pub.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Wart Is That?
programme.desc: Ex on the Beachs Zach og Kurtis utfordrer hverandre for å se hvem som er sjef. Kranglefantene Ant og Joe tar den vennskapelige kjeklingen til et helt nytt nivå, og Tian og Natalie får tatoveringer de sent vil glemme.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: You've Broken The Rules
programme.desc: Geordie Shore-stjernen Nathan er medvert for programmet med Charlotte. Kusinene Becky og Kodi skaper kaos. Panto-kompisene Josh og Jiimmy går hverandre i næringen og Ex On the Beach-stjernen Jack Devlin og vennen Andrew bryter reglene.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: The Valleys-stjernen Lateysha er medvert, og Big Brother-stjernen Aisleyne Horgan-Wallace og bestevenninna Amy sementerer vennskapet. Far og sønn Darren og Dean satser alt, og Jack og Crystal vender tilbake til showet.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Tatovøren Charl hjelper Charlotte som vert. Vennene Saffron og Sheniya gir hverandre en beskjed, mor og sønn Mary og Lewis setter familiebåndet på prøve, mens turtelduene Emily og Chris står overfor noen store avgjørelser.

programme.title: How Far Is Tattoo Far?: Bama Babes Bust Out
programme.desc: Floribama-bestevennene Nilsa og Aimee stiller opp for noen klargjørende tatoveringer som setter vennskapet på prøve. Søstre fra sør når et vendepunkt når en sjokkerende hemmelighet blir avslørt.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Scotty T's Initiation Tattoo
programme.desc: Scotty T har sin store innvielsesdag og han får baken brennmerket for livet. Hjelperne Curf og Omar tar guttas erting til det ekstreme og de konkurranseinnstilte brødrene Fran og Nic slår knute på familebåndene.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Forever Friends?
programme.desc: Chloe Ferry er gjestevert og bestevennene Benny og Scott prøver ut sin bromanse. Towie-stjernen Bobby Norris og vennen Charlie finner ut hvor godt de kjenner hverandre og kompisene Kobi og Macauley betviler sitt livslange vennskap.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Don't Go Upstairs and Swerve
programme.desc: Two brothers discover a horrifying secret when they inherit a relative's home. A school teacher struggles to learn the identity of the child-like spirit that's stalking her.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Paralyzed and The Baby Thief
programme.desc: A man suffering from sleep paralysis captures evidence that something is entering his room. A pregnant woman fears something is trying to harm her unborn child.

programme.title: Mutant X: Meaning of Death
programme.desc: Når en pest som bare rammer mutanter raser, blir Adam og Eckhart enige om å samarbeide for å finne en kur.

programme.title: Mutant X: Lit Fuse
programme.desc: Eckhart søker en mutant som kan absorbere energi, en som Brennan blir romantisk involvert med.

programme.title: Mutant X: In the Presence of Mine Enemies
programme.desc: Jesse blir forelsket i en datamaskinhacker, som Eckhart vil 'anskaffe' for å ødelegge de offentlige datanyhetskanalene mot nye mutanter ... og GSAs fordel.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Thank You Very Much
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Tyskland for å finne en tapt Elvis Presley-gitar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Transformation
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Derek Lloyd drar til den peruanske jungelen for å lete etter Paracelsus-rullene som inneholder formelen for å gjøre bly til gull.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: With the grand finale just around the corner, the remaining chefs are challenged to replicate a sample dish using taste, texture and sight alone. The winner is rewarded with a $1,000 shopping spree before another taxing evening service begins.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay presides over the penultimate episode of the US cooking competition as this year's explosive series nears its climax. Three contestants soon become two as Gordon names the second finalist.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay presides over the final episode of the US cooking competition as this year's explosive series reaches its climax. Gordon informs Mary and Ja'Nel that their teams will be creating dishes for two tables of celebrity diners.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: One contestant's overly speedy delivery arouses Gordon's suspicions. Will they be able to win back his respect during the first dinner service of the series?

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: In the second show of the series, the men hope to redress the balance after last week's disastrous start as they take on a beach side challenge. Later, a ruined risotto could spell the end of the line for one unlucky hopeful.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Livets sirkel
programme.desc: Walker etterforsker en rekke ran som leder ham til en overgangsbolig for straffedømte som er ute på prøve, og en av dem viser seg å være ektemannen til en nær venn.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Trosprøve
programme.desc: Walker blir vikarlærer på en skole som sliter med gjengrelatert vold for å etterforske drapet på en lærer som stod opp mot et gjengmedlem.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Bryllupet, del 1
programme.desc: Tragedie avbryter når Alex blir skutt av en tidligere straffedømt som mener at hun er ansvarlig for å putte ham i fengsel, akkurat da Walker skulle til å fri til henne.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Bryllupet, del 2
programme.desc: Alex klamrer seg så vidt fast til livet mens Walker sverger på å få Storm til å betale for sine handlinger.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Oppsporing
programme.desc: Walker må spore opp en feilaktig fengslet mann etter at han flykter fra fengselsvaktene som prøver å drepe ham.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et kongelig kupp
programme.desc: Idet en gjeng militære ranere planlegger å stjele sultanen av Kunais kongelige juveler og Walkers nemesis planlegger å henrette ham, går Trivette undercover som fluktbilsjåfør for å forpurre dobbeltplanen.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Operation Heart
programme.desc: The IMF races against time to convince the president (Pernell Roberts) of a small country that his chief of secret police plans to overthrow the government and seize power.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Slave pt. 1
programme.desc: The IMF is called upon to end an inhuman situation which the United Nations has been unable to abolish: slave trade in the country of Elkabar, ruled by King Ibn Borca.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Slave pt. 2
programme.desc: The IMF continues to battle slave-trading in a Middle Eastern country by eliminating De Groot, one of the principal suppliers of victims for King Borca's slave market.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Widow
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force is asked to destroy an international narcotics ring operated by Alex Cresnic and his partner Mark Walters.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Money Machine
programme.desc: The economy of the small African country of Ghalea is threatened by a mass counterfeiting scheme directed by Walter DuBruis, one of the country's richest financiers.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line og Kristian bygget drømmehuset sitt, trodde de i hvert fall. Åpne rom og store vinduer tiltaler dem ikke lenger, men hva skal de ha i stedet?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 704
programme.desc: For noen år siden solgte Birgitte huset sitt og angret bittert. Nå leier hun og datteren Emma et dyrt nybygg mens de leter etter et hus som ligner på det gamle. Kan ekspertene hjelpe dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 705
programme.desc: Pernille og Aron pendler den lange veien fra Odense til Kalundborg hver dag. Drømmen er å bo nærmere jobben, slik at de kan bruke fritiden på noe annet enn å sitte i bilen.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 706
programme.desc: Mie og Jakob har flyttet inn hos Jakobs mor for å spare til drømmehuset. Men er drømmehuset i det hele tatt på markedet? Tobias argumenterer for sin sak, og Mie og Jakob får seg et sjokk.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 707
programme.desc: Både Kristina og Dennis' familier har flyttet til Odense. Paret ønsker å flytte etter, men sliter med å finne tid til å gå på visninger. Tør de stole på ekspertene?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus's mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus's Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples under the power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi's chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi's Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Aftermath
programme.desc: Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi's mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Wrath of Rebecca
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ties of Friendship
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole the Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend the Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it's not the power of the cards, but the heart that's in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ledgendary Heroes, Part 1
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of Kaiba Corporation trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game. Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ledgendary Heroes, Part 2
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can YUGI and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ledgendary Heroes, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past a Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mailose all their life points!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Hidden Power!
programme.desc: After the crushing defeat of Cloister Divinity, Raimon step up to fill the hole, with Scotty the substitute helping out on Celia’s urging. The results are strange and disheartening, but also encouraging in one way.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback - Part 1!
programme.desc: Looks like Team Raimon have a new member, in the form of Sneaky Scotty. They’ll need all the help they can get though, because Ray Dark is back on the scene, in an unfeasibly silly submarine-based soccer stadium.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback Part 2!
programme.desc: Raimon are smack in the middle of a game against Royal Academy Redux, and Ray Dark has convinced its players to use any and every means to win; even if it means the destruction of their minds and bodies.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Last Wyvern Blizzard!
programme.desc: The Inazuma Caravan finally comes home to recharge their batteries and…train a whole lot more. They find out that everybody’s been training to help them, including some old enemies!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Erik Eagle in Serious Trouble!
programme.desc: No sooner do they arrive home, and they’re back on the road again - this time they’re heading to Osaka where it’s rumoured that Alius Academy have a base.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Dvalin’s Trap!
programme.desc: The team find that the Golden Glamour Girls’ secret training bunker under the amusement park is a great place to train, but where did it come from?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Epsilon - The Toughest Battle Yet!
programme.desc: The big game against Epsilon is here, and Raimon come out with all guns blazing! Will their guns be enough to turn back the alien scourge?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Grandpa’s Secret Trick!
programme.desc: Unexpected news about the existence of another David Evans notebook sends the team scurrying off to Fukuoka, where they meet one of Mark’s grandfather’s old friends, and someone who might just become Mark’s apprentice.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Other Majin the Hand!
programme.desc: The exhibition game between Raimon and Fauxshore Jr - AKA the battle of the goalies - is a knuckle biting affair. Both Mark and Darren are showing off their old moves and trying to learn new ones while a storm of shots rages around them.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Seismic Earthquake Shocker!
programme.desc: Just when Raimon were feeling confident, they get a wake up call in the form of a big slap in the face from Xavier and his Genesis team. Sure, part of being a winning team is being able to cope with loss, but a loss this big?

programme.title: Aliens in the USSR
programme.desc: Uløste utenomjordiske mysterier blir utforsket! Sovjetunionen: Dyatlov Pass-hendelsen, Petrozavodsk-miraklet og Voronezh-saken er saker som fascinere og skremmer. Vi utforsker om romvesener var involvert. Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: The Falcon Lake Incident
programme.desc: Jorden får ofte besøk av romvesener, og UFO-hendelsen ved Falcon Lake i Canada i 1967 skiller seg ut. Her utforsker vi Canadas hyppige observasjoner! Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Dogfights
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, military pilots allegedly not only saw UFOs but engaged them. The team gets special access to ex-pilots in Iran and Peru who followed strange objects.

programme.title: UFO Hunters II: Tales from the Universe
programme.desc: Italienske ufologer utforsker spor etter romvesener i historie og folklore. Har vi blitt overvåket siden oldtiden? Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Reckoning"
programme.desc: A woman whom Father knows returns to the city. She asks him to join her and he considers it. At the same time Diana is working on a murder. And it turns that the victim is someone Father knows.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Legacies
programme.desc: Upon returning to "The World Below" upon the knowledge of some of ex-tunnel inhabitants being murdered, Father encounters Gregory Coyle who seeks revenge for the death of his father by cave-in 20 years ago.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Once Upon a Time in the City of New York
programme.desc: Attacked, mutilated and left for dead, Catherine Chandler is rescued by the mysterious man-beast called Vincent.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Terrible Savior
programme.desc: Witness descriptions of a vigilante lead Catherine to fear Vincent may be a killer.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Siege
programme.desc: Vincent helps the residents of an apartment building defend their homes against thugs who want them out so the land can be re-developed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Blue Scorpion
programme.desc: The emergence of the elusive Blue Scorpion leads anthropology professor Jeff Storck (Chris O'Dowd) to his most personal research project yet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Blurryman
programme.desc: Writer Sophie Gelson (Zazie Beetz) is haunted by a mysterious figure. Seth Rogen and Betty Gabriel guest star.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programme.desc: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Bigalow'S Last Smoke
programme.desc: Mr. Bigalow, a lifelong cigarette smoker, wakes up to find that his windows have bars on them and his door is sealed shut. A mysterious figure appears on Bigalow's television, informing him that he will quit smoking.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The False Prophet
programme.desc: Cassie Pines is a woman traveling on her own who believes in astrology, tea leaves...e everything. She comes into a diner with a most unusual mechanical fortune teller named Horace X.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Impressionist
programme.desc: An impressionist, "Mr. Personalities," is brought in by the government to try to help them communicate with an alien. Mr. Personalities is at first stumped but finally makes "contact."

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Lifebomb
programme.desc: Ben Martin, a rich businessman, is contacted by a special medical firm, "Lifebomb" which offers him an expensive policy that will let him live forever. They give him an implanted device which, every time he "dies," activates.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ring Around The Redhead
programme.desc: As Billy is waiting to be executed in the electric chair, he relates the bizarre tale of how he came to be in his predicament at the hands of an attractive woman.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Parlour Floor Front
programme.desc: A woman becomes concerned when she discovers that a man that she and her husband rent a room to has been practicing voodoo. Although the man is good intentioned and kind, the woman regards him as a threatening and undesirable tenant.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Halloween Candy
programme.desc: A mean old man harboring an intense hatred for the celebration of Halloween is left alone by his son to hand out candy to the neighborhood children.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Satanic Piano
programme.desc: Pete Bancroft is a talented pianist who has lost his inspiration, but is contacted by a mysterious inventor who gives him a piano that lets him play as never before simply by thinking of the music. Bancroft is at first relieved.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Devil'S Advocate
programme.desc: A hate-style radio host, Mandrake, spews out venom at anyone who calls in. He soon discovers, however, after receiving calls across all of time that he is dead but that the "Boss," has kept him on.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Distant Signals
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: JAG: Good Intentions
programme.desc: Mac defends a petty officer and former alcoholic accused of a brutal murder after a drinking binge which renders him useless in remembering details that could help him. Roberts is entangled in the case of a Navy Commander accused of embezzling funds.

programme.title: JAG: People vs SECNAV
programme.desc: After an incident in Iraq claims the lives of innocent civilians, SecNav is brought up on charges of war crimes in International Court, and Harm and Mac must defend him. Meanwhile, during a trip to the arcade, little A.J. goes missing.

programme.title: JAG: Hard Time
programme.desc: Mac must accompany a prisoner who once assaulted her across the country while Harm and Bud delve into the case of an HIV-infected fleet officer who, after having his condition revealed and relegated to inactive duty, wants his old job back.

programme.title: JAG: Coming Home
programme.desc: A marine’s killing in Iraq has ramifications for JAG stateside as Harm helps the soldier’s family with a media onslaught, and Bud and Mac investigate the failure of his flack vest.

programme.title: JAG: Fighting Words
programme.desc: A general’s comments about Islam during a church service pit Harm and Mac against each other as a court-martial hearing examines whether those remarks were a danger to national security.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Second Time Around, Hello, Spencer, Runaway, Go Home

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 13-Year-Old Father?
programme.desc: Curtis sat down with his mother Telisha, and told her that he is trying to have a baby but Telisha was shocked and terrified because Curtis is only 13 years old! Curtis insists he is ready to be a father.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
programme.desc: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
programme.desc: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
